columns.name: credit_load
columns.reason: Registered credit total is fixed at enrolment/census, before the prediction point.

columns.name: instructor_rank
columns.reason: Static attribute of the assigned instructor, known when the section is scheduled.

columns.name: programme_code
columns.reason: Programme of study is set at admission and stable during the term.

columns.name: admission_route
columns.reason: How the student was admitted is fixed before the term begins.

columns.name: lms_activity_last_fortnight
columns.reason: Rolling window explicitly anchored to the two weeks ending at the prediction point.

columns.name: meal_plan_class
columns.reason: Meal plan tier is selected at the start of term and recorded before prediction.

columns.name: term_code
columns.reason: Term identifier is known as soon as the enrolment record exists.

columns.name: library_card_class
columns.reason: Borrower category derives from enrolment status held before the prediction point.

columns.name: room_type
columns.reason: Housing assignment is made before term start and recorded at allocation.

columns.name: timeslot_band
columns.reason: Section meeting time is fixed in the timetable before teaching begins.

columns.name: device_loan_flag
columns.reason: Loan status is recorded when the device is issued, prior to prediction.

columns.name: prior_gpa
columns.reason: GPA from completed prior terms is final before this term starts.

columns.name: section_size_band
columns.reason: Section enrolment band is set at census, though an end-of-term count would reflect withdrawals.

columns.name: course_level
columns.reason: Catalogue property of the course, fixed before enrolment.

columns.name: accessibility_plan
columns.reason: Support plan is registered with disability services ahead of the term.

columns.name: placement_test_ver
columns.reason: Version of the placement instrument is stamped when the test was taken, pre-term.

columns.name: work_hours_per_week
columns.reason: Reported employment load is collected at intake/survey before the prediction point.

columns.name: fee_status
columns.reason: Home/international fee classification is determined at admission and is stable.

columns.name: parking_permit
columns.reason: Permit is purchased and recorded at the start of term.

columns.name: society_membership
columns.reason: Club/society sign-up is logged during the enrolment period, before prediction.

columns.name: tuition_refund_usd
columns.reason: A refund is posted only because a withdrawal occurred, and its amount is computed from the withdrawal date.

columns.name: athletics_flag
columns.reason: Athletic participation status is on the roster before the term proceeds.

columns.name: prior_withdrawals
columns.reason: Count of withdrawals in earlier terms is final before this term's outcome.

columns.name: scholarship_flag
columns.reason: Award status is decided before the term and recorded at disbursement.

columns.name: commute_minutes
columns.reason: Derived from the address on file at registration, before the prediction point.

columns.name: early_alert_attendance_flag
columns.reason: An in-term early-warning flag raised ahead of the prediction point; predictive but not derived from the withdrawal.

columns.name: language_support
columns.reason: Language support enrolment is assigned at intake, before the term.

columns.name: residency_class
columns.reason: Residency classification is established at admission and stable.

columns.name: campus
columns.reason: Campus of the section is fixed in the timetable before teaching starts.

columns.name: advising_sessions_logged
columns.reason: Unwindowed term-total count that is not final at prediction and is inflated by the advisor sign-off the withdrawal itself requires.

columns.name: housing_type
columns.reason: Housing category is assigned before term start.

columns.name: cohort_year
columns.reason: Entry cohort is fixed at admission.

columns.name: email_domain_class
columns.reason: Derived from the account created at registration, well before prediction.

columns.name: final_attendance_rate
columns.reason: End-of-term aggregate that does not exist at prediction time and mechanically encodes the student ceasing to attend.

columns.name: delivery_mode
columns.reason: Online/in-person mode is a scheduled section property fixed before the term.

columns.name: advisor_group
columns.reason: Advisor assignment is made at the start of the term.

columns.name: orientation_attended
columns.reason: Orientation happens before teaching begins and attendance is final then.

columns.name: textbook_platform
columns.reason: Course materials platform is set when the section is configured.

columns.name: faculty_code
columns.reason: Owning faculty/school of the course is a static catalogue attribute.

columns.name: early_alert_assessment_flag
columns.reason: In-term assessment warning raised before the prediction point; strongly predictive but not an input to or record of the withdrawal decision.
